description:
The useless god was framed, but the modern strategist inside him just AWOKE! ⚡️😱 Watch till the end for the insane plot twist! 

Kaelos, the disgraced bastard son of Zeus, wakes up in chains before the Tribunal of Olympus. Accused of desecrating Athena’s temple and stealing the Fire of Wisdom, Hera demands him cast into Tartarus. But they didn't count on one thing—he’s no longer the cowardly trash they knew! Watch how he uses modern logic to turn the tables on Ares and shock all of Olympus...

👇 Don't miss a single episode! SUBSCRIBE for more epic god fights & plot twists!
👍 Hit LIKE if you love a satisfying revenge arc!
